description.p: stoandl is a GTK4 / libadwaita front-end for the stoandl Pebble companion daemon on Linux. It manages a Pebble smartwatch over Bluetooth: watch faces and apps, host-side extensions, notification forwarding and styling, calendar and health sync, and firmware and language-pack updates.
Convergent by design — the same app runs on the desktop and on Linux phones (phosh / postmarketOS). It is a thin D-Bus client of the (separately installed) stoandl daemon and does not bundle it.
This is the GTK build of the GUI; a Kirigami (Qt) build of the same app is packaged separately as de.yoxcu.stoandl.gui, and the two install side by side.
Initial packaged release with a desktop launcher entry and application icon.
